governed_extension.authorization: I authorize a governed out-of-band schema migration/write for issue #148 to materialize the complete acceptance and issue matrices, including missing NFR/C criteria, issue metadata, and terminal-owner metadata, followed by Spec Kitty task re-finalization.

criteria.description: Publish one sk-bar-chart element for one ordered numeric series.
criteria.notes: Element registration/export and exact public member-set evidence.

criteria.description: Export readonly BarDatum and series types with id, label, value, and displayValue.
criteria.notes: Element and generated-consumer type checks, including malformed negative cases.

criteria.description: Accept structured series only as a public property with a frozen empty default and removal reset, never as JSON attribute text.
criteria.notes: Element, manifest, React, Vue, replacement, and removal-reset assertions.

criteria.description: Render label and displayValue as exact literal text, never parse formatted text or create descendant markup from either field, and permit no input-driven side effect.
criteria.notes: Literal-untrusted-text behavior and browser assertions.

criteria.description: Derive every height as zero-anchored value divided by the current maximum, with an all-zero guard, expressed through numeric SVG geometry rather than dynamic inline style.
criteria.notes: Exact ratio table plus direct formula source-break evidence.

criteria.description: Render a subtle zero baseline and restrained scale and grid guidance.
criteria.notes: DOM, token-binding, forced-colors, and visual evidence.

criteria.description: Keep each label and display value visibly present so no meaning depends on hover.
criteria.notes: Persistent text and interaction-state browser assertions.

criteria.description: Expose the chart name and description and every label and value pair to assistive technology in exact input order.
criteria.notes: Accessibility-tree/source-order assertions and axe.

criteria.description: Render a labelled empty state for absent or empty series with zero bars and activation targets.
criteria.notes: Empty/default/property-removal behavior and Storybook evidence.

criteria.description: Reject the whole runtime series for malformed records, duplicate or blank IDs, blank required text, or negative or non-finite values, and render no partial chart.
criteria.notes: Exhaustive fail-closed validation table and source-break evidence.

criteria.description: Default selectable to false; only true creates activation surfaces, tab stops, interaction states, and events.
criteria.notes: Positive and negative behavior and Playwright assertions.

criteria.description: Project selectedId only when it matches a current datum; activation never mutates it.
criteria.notes: Controlled-selection replacement and non-mutation assertions.

criteria.description: Use one native click path so pointer, Enter, and Space each produce one equivalent activation without key-repeat duplication.
criteria.notes: Real-input parity and repeat-key suppression evidence.

criteria.description: Export and document sk-bar-chart-select with exact readonly { id: string } detail, bubbles true, composed true, and cancelable false.
criteria.notes: Element behavior, mutation, manifest, React callback, and document-boundary evidence.

criteria.description: Expose focus and selected states with shape or border plus valid programmatic state, never color alone; under forced colors keyboard focus retains an outline and remains distinguishable from controlled selection.
criteria.notes: Real focus/selection state and forced-colors source-break evidence.

criteria.description: Use bounded items and horizontal scrolling or a compact treatment that keeps every label, value, and bar owned without overlap or meaning-changing truncation.
criteria.notes: 390 by 844 geometry, scrolling, hit-test, and full-text assertions.

criteria.description: Render an identical semantic signature in default dark and .sk-light themes before permitting only themed color variance.
criteria.notes: Ordered semantics and computed-theme comparison before color assertions.

criteria.description: Add and consume reusable data-series, grid, and baseline semantic tokens, and do not use gold as the default series color.
criteria.notes: Token source/catalogue, computed binding, and forbidden-color evidence.

criteria.description: Document exact token dependencies and a minimal structural part surface; every declared part is rendered and externally targetable.
criteria.notes: CSS-to-doc token equality and seven-part conformance evidence.

criteria.description: Register through guarded define(), export from both element entries, adopt the generated sheet by identity, and inject zero style elements.
criteria.notes: Entry, distribution, SC-014, and generated-sheet assertions.

criteria.description: Provide approved four-bucket, close unequal, zero, empty, long/date-stamped, controlled selectable, interaction-state, and LightMode stories.
criteria.notes: Eight-story index ratchet, non-empty load, and axe traversal.

criteria.description: Regenerate CSS module, token catalogue, CEM, React wrapper, wrapper floor, Vue declaration, and SIZES; update all component ratchets and extend the packed-consumer gate while preserving #149; at wrap-up recheck #112 and add the formal row if available or record verified deferral.
criteria.notes: Generated drift, packed-consumer, refreshed-train #112 disposition, and exact-head evidence.

criteria.description: Prove series, selectedId, selectable, and event detail reach the generated React wrapper without any, including replacement and removal through the production hook.
criteria.notes: Dedicated React runtime and type evidence.

criteria.description: Record named red-first mutations for every applicable behavior invariant and direct source-break proof for scale, validation, controlled selection, theming, forced-colors focus, and narrow ownership.
criteria.notes: WP red/green records and mutation-fleet evidence.

criteria.description: Every required rendered story reports zero WCAG 2.1 AA axe violations; a failed or empty load is a failure.
criteria.notes: Eight non-empty stories plus axe selftest and full scan.

criteria.description: Pointer, Enter, and Space each emit exactly one byte-equivalent { id } record with bubbling and composed true and cancelable false for the same datum; repeat emits zero extra events.
criteria.notes: Real-input event parity and repeat assertions.

criteria.description: For every finite valid value, rendered ratio data equals value divided by maximum exactly; equal and zero cases are exact.
criteria.notes: Exact geometry and recomputation assertions.

criteria.description: At 390 by 844, zero label, value, or bar ownership overlaps or cross-item hit targets occur before or after horizontal scrolling.
criteria.notes: Narrow viewport bounding-box and hit-test assertions.

criteria.description: Default and LightMode have identical ordered semantics before themed color comparison; documented data surfaces differ where intended, and forced colors preserves meaning, outline focus, and selection in both themes.
criteria.notes: Semantic-signature, computed-token, axe, and forced-colors evidence.

criteria.description: Required real-input behavior passes locally available Chromium and Firefox for lane approval and Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit in exact-head PR CI; local WebKit is additional evidence only through a repository-defined container seam.
criteria.notes: WP01 authors the shared contract; exact-head PR CI owns WebKit.

criteria.description: Every generated-artifact check, manifest diff, Vue source-SFC check, and post-build packed-consumer check is clean after regeneration from final integrated source.
criteria.notes: Ordered generation, source checks, and real-tarball no-alias type gate.

criteria.description: Every declared behavior-and-subject mutation turns its named assertion red and 100 percent of registered mutations are killed within the repository budget.
criteria.notes: WP03 runs the local fleet; wrap-up records exact-head CI count and time.

criteria.description: A checked-in fail-closed wrapper terminates the Storybook build and exits nonzero at 180 seconds; once the Storybook job runs its build step is unconditional and uses the wrapper; final-head duration is below 180 seconds.
criteria.notes: WP03 creates and self-tests the wrapper and wiring; wrap-up records exact-head CI timing.

criteria.description: CI-authoritative cropped baselines for approved dark, LightMode, narrow, zero or empty, and selectable states receive explicit visual-review disposition against the approved capture.
criteria.notes: Wrap-up owns CI actual-byte provenance, disposition, committed baselines, and fresh green CI.

criteria.description: No fetching, store, router, timer, time-window, currency or spend total, deployment arithmetic, selected application object, or action callback lives in the element.
criteria.notes: Forbidden-source and dependency-boundary checks on the integrated lane.

criteria.description: No second series, deployment annotation, tooltip-only meaning, or public Team Kitty overview element is introduced.
criteria.notes: Public API and forbidden-source/content checks.

criteria.description: Do not modify components owned by #145 through #147 or #149, and do not create replacements for card, grid, button, pill, or navigation components.
criteria.notes: Diff-scope and ownership verification.

criteria.description: Keep one authored CSS source and one authored structured render source, with no hand-authored duplicate markup or static form.
criteria.notes: Generated-markup and authored-source absence checks.

criteria.description: All component CSS design values use --sk-* tokens; data-derived proportions use numeric SVG geometry, with no dynamic inline style, raw design values, or cross-shadow theme selectors.
criteria.notes: Stylelint, CSS hygiene, theme boundary, and geometry checks.

criteria.description: Only inherited tokens, declared parts, and documented component custom properties are public; internal BEM classes are private.
criteria.notes: Manifest, part ratchet, and styling-boundary evidence.

criteria.description: Never hand-edit generated CSS modules, static outputs, custom-elements.json, React wrappers, Vue declarations, token catalogue, or SIZES.
criteria.notes: Ordered generators followed by drift checks and clean status.

criteria.description: Preserve the serial integration protocol: refresh the clean planning target before first claim and before consolidation, use Spec Kitty-owned lane dependency propagation, and never rewrite a captured baseline.
criteria.notes: Final owner records current train, finalized planning SHA, supported propagation, and baseline provenance.

criteria.description: Use one #148 design-mission branch and one pull request into train/elements-first with Refs #148, superseding the unrelated SaaS WP-per-PR convention for this checkout.
criteria.notes: Wrap-up owns the single PR target and metadata check.

criteria.description: Do not merge train to main, publish packages, deploy Team Kitty, or broaden component scope.
criteria.notes: Lane review and wrap-up verify authorization and scope boundaries.

criteria.description: Run three independent profile-loaded Codex lenses after tasks and again pre-merge, at most two passes per point-cut, with exact-SHA evidence.
criteria.notes: Post-tasks evidence is planning-stage; wrap-up owns exact-final-head lens evidence.
